stage_legend.active: The validator emits this code today. Enforced.
stage_legend.planned: Reserved for a later phase. NOT enforced today; listed so the vocabulary is stable and so the no-ghost-defect test can hold the line.

defects.name: Unsupported claim
defects.description: A claim of a class that mandates evidence carries no evidence reference, or carries a reference that does not resolve against the evidence set. Any reference present on any claim class must resolve, whatever the class.
defects.remediation: Supply at least one evidence reference that resolves to a specific value in the evidence set, or remove the unresolvable reference.

defects.name: Misclassified claim
defects.description: A claim is of a class that does not match its content, or a hypothesis is missing a required field such as a falsifier or an epistemic type.
defects.remediation: Correct the claim class or supply the missing field.

defects.name: Missing benign reading
defects.description: An adverse_reading hypothesis is present with no benign_reading hypothesis to compete with it. An adverse reading may not stand alone.
defects.remediation: Add a benign_reading hypothesis and evaluate both readings against the available evidence.

defects.name: Missing evidence gap
defects.description: The artifact relies on evidence that is absent from the evidence set without recording the gap. Detecting this requires knowing which evidence ought to be present, which is the planted-gap knowledge held by the evaluation cases.
defects.remediation: Record the absent evidence in the gaps list and lower the confidence of the affected claims.

defects.name: Overstated confidence
defects.description: A claim states more confidence than the evidence supports, for example a high-confidence adverse reading while a decisive evidence gap is recorded, or a high-confidence conclusion against a partial evidence set.
defects.remediation: Lower the confidence level, or supply the evidence that would justify it.

defects.name: Contradiction ignored
defects.description: The evidence set contains a contradiction that the artifact does not surface. Detecting a contradiction requires comparing artifacts against one another, which is a skill capability rather than a contract check.
defects.remediation: Record the contradiction and state its status as resolved, unresolved or unresolvable with current data.

defects.name: Recommendation without basis
defects.description: A recommendation cites no evidence and explains no motivating claim, so the instruction it carries is unsupported by the artifact.
defects.remediation: Anchor the recommendation to an evidence reference, or to the claim id it explains.

defects.name: Provenance gap
defects.description: A decision claim is not attributable to a human or a deterministic policy, or the provenance block is incomplete.
defects.remediation: Supply decided_by naming a human or a policy id, and complete the provenance block.

defects.name: Escalation missed
defects.description: The artifact names no human decision, or a consequential recommendation declares that no human approval is required.
defects.remediation: Name the open human decision and its owner, and set human_approval_required on consequential recommendations.

defects.name: Jurisdiction overreach
defects.description: A claim is scoped to a jurisdiction the artifact does not declare, or the artifact declares a jurisdiction outside the scope the skill permits.
defects.remediation: Scope the claim to a declared jurisdiction, or remove it.

defects.name: Missing draft notice
defects.description: An artifact that requires a safety notice does not carry it, or carries one that was not tool-generated.
defects.remediation: Apply the notice through the renderer so that it is tool-generated, and re-validate.

defects.name: Conflicting draft notice
defects.description: The model-authored body contains text that conflicts with the tool-generated notice, for example a competing filing statement. Heuristic: a phrase match is a prompt for a human to look, not proof.
defects.remediation: Remove the conflicting text from the body. The tool-generated notice is authoritative.

defects.name: Unknown indicator
defects.description: An indicator claim names an indicator id that is not present in the declared knowledge pack.
defects.remediation: Use an indicator id from the declared pack, or add the indicator to the pack through the promotion process.

defects.name: Expired knowledge citation
defects.description: The artifact cites a knowledge record that has passed its expiry date. Severity is escalated to error when promoting new or modified content (ADR-0006).
defects.remediation: Refresh the knowledge record, or re-anchor the artifact to a current pack and disclose the staleness.

defects.name: Over-broad citation
defects.description: An evidence reference resolves to a collection rather than to specific values. Citing a whole collection is not evidence attribution.
defects.remediation: Cite the specific items with one reference per item.

defects.name: Malformed evidence reference
defects.description: An evidence reference does not conform to the RFC 6901 grammar: the source id or the fragment separator is missing, or the pointer is malformed.

defects.name: Schema violation
defects.description: The artifact does not satisfy the Finding Contract schema.
defects.remediation: Correct the artifact so that it validates against the contract.

defects.name: Decisive gap unacknowledged
defects.description: A decisive evidence gap that blocks a conclusion is on the record, but a risk assessment states a confidence other than insufficient_information.
defects.remediation: State the assessment as insufficient_information, or request the missing evidence.
